scope: Proposition 3.1 (Boundary separation) of the manuscript “Log abundance in numerical dimension one for threefolds in positive characteristic” (preprints/Log-abundance-in-numerical-dimension-one-for-threefolds-in-positive-characteristic-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 035 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0938366c005f8930), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a normal Q-factorial projective threefold over an uncountable algebraically closed field, and let B be an effective Q-divisor. Suppose that N is a nonzero effective nef Cartier divisor with ν(N) = 1, n(N) = 3, and N ∼Q a(KX + B) for some rational a > 0. For every ample Cartier divisor H, one has BNH = 0. (5) Consequently N is numerically trivial on each prime component of B, and every such component is either contained in Supp N or disjoint from Supp N.
